description: بیسکویت مغز استخوان با مغزی طعم گوشت گاو، مناسب توله‌های بالای ۶ ماه و سگ بالغ؛ غنی‌شده با ویتامین‌های A، D۳ و E.
bodyDescription: Small marrow biscuits with a beef-flavoured filling, suitable for puppies from 6 months onwards and adult dogs.These delicious, crunchy biscuits can be given as a reward during training or simply as a snack to spoil your four-legged friend. Also ideal during the daily walk. Moreover, the biscuits are enriched with vitamins A, D3 and E !
